title: Inventory
intro: Every device Floorbit knows, with its interfaces. What you change here wins over a sync.
syncDone: Synced: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{gone}} gone, {{locked}} edited fields kept.
noSources: No plugin feeds the inventory. Turn on NetBox under Settings > Plugins to fill it from there.
deleteFed: Hide {{name}}? It comes from {{source}}, so it is hidden rather than deleted, and the next sync won't bring it back.
hostHint: The server or cluster host this VM runs on.

library.title: Icon library
library.intro: SVG icons for devices, groups, tags and the floor plan. Floorbit keeps only the shapes (no scripts, links or styles) and draws them in the colour you pick. At most {{kb}} KB each.
library.name: Name
library.removeQ: Remove the icon {{name}}? Devices, groups and tags that show it go back to their default icon, icons on the floor plan to the info icon.

look.title: Icon and colour
look.pickColor: Pick a colour from the screen

types.title: Inventory types
types.intro: Every entry in the inventory has a type. Give a type its own fields (text, number, choice, yes/no or a link to another entry) and settings all its entries inherit.
types.inherit: Every entry of this type gets

linkedHint.cable: Cables are added and changed on the Cables page; here they get groups, tags, fields and notes.
linkedHint.circuit: Circuits are added and changed on the Power page; here they get groups, tags, fields and notes.
linkedHint.power-board: Power boards are added and changed on the Power page; here they get groups, tags, fields and notes.
linkedHint.patch-panel: Patch panels are placed on the floor plan; here they get groups, tags, fields and notes.

groups.title: Groups
groups.allHint: Settings, feature switches and credentials for every device, unless a group, a tag or the device says otherwise.
groups.saveFirst: Create it first, then add settings, feature switches and credentials.
groups.deleteQ: Remove the group {{name}}? Its devices and groups move up one level; nothing is deleted.

tags.title: Tags
tags.label: Tags
tags.none: No tags yet: make one in the list of tags
tags.deleteQ: Remove the tag {{name}}? It comes off every device and group that has it.
tags.outlineHint: Outlined tags come from the device's group.

features.title: Feature switches
features.pluginsHint: A plugin works on a device only where it is switched on here, on a tag or group, or for all devices, and a credential resolves.

creds.title: Credentials
creds.intro: The logins this device uses, and where each comes from. One set on the device wins over its tags and groups.
creds.inheritIntro: Devices in it use these unless a closer tag, group or the device has its own.
creds.removeQ: Remove the {{kind}} credential? Devices fall back to what their tags and groups have.
creds.keep: Leave empty to keep the stored one
creds.writeOnly: Write-only: Floorbit never shows it again. Opened only when used, and each use is in the audit log.

blocks.title: Stored login blocked
blocks.line: The {{kind}} failed for {{by}} at {{when}}. Nothing tries it again until it is cleared.
blocks.techsClear: A tech clears it once the login is fixed.

ifaces.name: Interface
ifaces.namesHint: One, several (comma) or a range: Gi1/0/1-48
ifaces.lockedHint: Fields with an unlock button were changed by hand; {{source}} won't overwrite them.

runsHere.title: Runs here
runsHere.hint: If this device goes down, these go down with it.

syncEvery: Syncs on its own every {{minutes}} minutes.

telemetry.off: The Telemetry feature is off for this device. Turn it on under Settings (here, or on its group or a tag) to collect from it.
telemetry.agentHint: The local agent that collects from it. While that agent is away, the others take over.
telemetry.portsHint: Empty: the group above decides, or the usual port. Traps and MDT come in on the agent's own ports.
telemetry.groupIntro: Every device in this group takes these unless it sets its own.
telemetry.collectInherit: Off unless a group, a tag or all devices turn it on.
telemetry.autoGroup: Each device by its software and logins: SNMP polling and traps with an SNMP login, NX-API, RESTCONF or the OPNsense API with an API login.
telemetry.nothing: nothing yet (no login, nothing that sends by itself)
telemetry.methodsHint: Polling and the APIs need a login under Credentials. Traps, Cisco MDT, gNMI and a firewall's own Telegraf need the device set up to send (Device setup shows what to paste).
telemetry.needsLogin: Some of these need a login this device doesn't have yet. Add it under Credentials, here or on its group.
telemetry.trapPort: Traps go to the agent's UDP port {{port}} (v2c).
telemetry.trapPortV3: Traps go to the agent's UDP port {{port}}, as the SNMPv3 user {{user}}. Each trap user has its own port.
telemetry.trapNoPort: Every trap listener on the agent belongs to another SNMPv3 trap user, so this device's traps go nowhere. Give it a trap user that already has a port.
telemetry.autoFdb: Automatic: per VLAN on Cisco IOS and IOS-XE, the standard table otherwise
telemetry.vlansAuto: The VLANs on each device's interfaces
telemetry.vlansHint: Empty: the VLANs on its interfaces.
telemetry.addressHint: Only when it isn't the management address (behind a NAT, a forwarded port).
telemetry.urlHint: Only when the API isn't at https:// and the address above.
telemetry.verifyNo: No, it has its own certificate

page.notFound: This item is not in the inventory
page.telemetryAdmins: Admins see the last word, Test now and Raw data here.
